Name: ragdollnoelle's K's Barn Animals
Author: ragdollnoelle
Description:
[center][/center][left][b][size=5]──⋆⋅☆⋅⋆── [u]ragdollnoelle's conversion of Kwillow's barn animals[/u] ──⋆⋅☆⋅⋆──[/size][/b]

[size=2]I have taken Kwillow's barn animals ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2933]cow[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2996]sheep[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2945]pig[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2964/]goat[/url]﻿) & I have converted the files into a alternative texture so you can incorporate all
of the barn animals at once into your game! Kwillow has not returned in several years, & currently you can only choose 1 file for each animal
to replace the original sprite. Now you can have all of them at once in your game! [/size]

[b][size=5]How to use:[/size]
[/b] [size=3]➳ When buying new barn animals, or new barn animals being born, they will randomly come with a new texture.
﻿➳ If you already have animals, you can buy the blue/red scissors from Robin & change the texture yourself.[/size][size=4]﻿[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b]

[b]A huge HUGE shoutout & thank you to daedreamexe for allowing me to use their mod files on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20036?tab=description]Cow Diversity[/url]﻿ mod
to implement this! This was my first mod project. I am beyond thankful. Please check them out if you haven't already! Their
cow diversity is ADORABLE!![/b][/left][size=3][b]
[/b][/size][b][size=4]INSTRUCTIONS:[/size]
[/b][size=3] ﻿➳ Download my conversion file, & unzip. Move the folder to your mods folder.
﻿➳ Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mods downloaded.

[/size]I hope you all enjoy! Thanks again!

If there are any issues in regards to this mod, please contact me.
